items.en_title: Boston South End first-come closes May 13, 2027: 26 homes, a rare large downtown batch
items.en_oneliner: A first-come opening in Boston's South End closes May 13, 2027 with 26 homes, a rare large batch downtown; the deadline is far off, but a batch this size deserves a calendar mark now so it is not forgotten by spring.
